Small steps, meaningful learning

More than an answer.
A place to begin.

Our approach to scaffolding is simple: meet a question with a manageable idea, leave room to think, and connect it to the world.

01 / WONDER

Start with a spark.

A question about the Moon. A seed on the sidewalk. A story that makes them pause. Curiosity gives the moment a purpose.

“What is inside a seed?”
02 / DISCOVER

Make room to think.

One clear idea at a time. A useful hint when something is tricky. An optional next step when they want to explore a little further.

A tiny plant, with food to get started.
03 / TAKE IT WITH YOU

Back to their world.

The best next moment might happen away from the device: noticing, counting, building, or asking a grown-up something new.

“Let’s look at a plant together.”
Look. Check. Ask.From Trustin and the Curled Leaf

Good questions

A few things
you might
be wondering.

What is TrustinJr?
TrustinJr is an audio-first early-learning app in development: a child explores questions, prepared discoveries, illustrated stories and early math on Apple Watch, while a parent manages settings on iPhone. It is a learning tool with a friendly character, not a replacement for the people in a child’s life.
What ages is it being designed for?
The first experience focuses on children ages 4–5. Children develop at different rates, so a parent’s judgment matters. Broader age and ability progression is a future direction, not a feature promised by this preview.
Is this demo using live AI or recording my voice?
No. The demo uses prepared questions, answers and story content. Narration is prerecorded in Trustin’s voice. The microphone-shaped button opens sample questions; it does not activate your microphone. Settings and sample activity reset when this page reloads.
What can parents decide?
The design puts family topic preferences and listening settings in the parent’s hands, above essential child-safety protections. Try the sample Parent Dock to see a topic move from independent exploration to a conversation with a grown-up. The dock is an illustrative browser preview, not a final screenshot of every native feature.
Can AI make mistakes or miss a boundary?
Yes. AI can be inaccurate and safeguards can fail. TrustinJr’s approach uses age-appropriate content and safeguards, with parent preferences as an additional layer. No system can promise perfect filtering. Important, sensitive or confusing questions belong with a trusted grown-up.
Will there be advertising to children?
No child-facing advertising, sponsored answers or pressure to buy. That is a core TrustinJr commitment. We also design for natural stopping points rather than endless feeds, streak pressure or rewards for staying longer.
Can I download it? Will it work on my child’s Watch?
TrustinJr is currently in development and testing. A public App Store release and launch date have not been announced here. The current beta uses a Watch normally paired with an iPhone; Family Setup onboarding is not supported in that beta. Read the current availability note before making a device purchase.
Do I need to pay or create an account to try this?
The scripted website demo is free to try, with no account, payment or real child profile. Product pricing has not been announced. If you are interested in future availability, email the project.
